title: Seven Winters and One Short Line
subtitle: 挫折振作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 挫折振作（人与自我·做人与做事）
meta: 主题语境：挫折振作（人与自我·做人与做事）　|　核心词汇：fact　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 fact 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 my father ① faced a fact that no clerk in the office would have written, and he said the facing was the whole of the winter. The ② fact, meaning the truth itself and not the claim, ran seven winters and stayed unwritten in the book; a fact, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left unwritten.

Every ③ fact in that office had the same short line beside it, and the ④ fact at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the report and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A fact, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to write; my father said the writing is the part that fills seven winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the fact was the whole of the matter, meaning the reality and not the truth. The ⑥ fact, meaning the reality and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody writes; fact, he said, is either something you face or the only word that means both a truth and a reality. He said the reality is the part they remember.

By 1970 the ⑦ fact had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short line. The ⑧ fact of the whole thing, my father wrote in January, was one office and seven winters of writing; fact, he said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to write. He said the writing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ fact I remember is the one written in the file, which closed in 1973 and is still described as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ fact, my mother said in 1975, is the only one that improves by being written; every fact, she said, is a reality that has agreed to look like a truth. She said the reality was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 事实（指办公室里每一条旁边的那一条）
B. n. 事实（指那一条真相本身，与说法相对）
C. 固定搭配：face a fact 面对一个事实
D. n. 事实（指留给报告的那一条）
E. n. 事实（抽象总称，指一间办公室的事实之事）
F. n. 事实（指卷宗上写到、被记下的那一条）
G. n. 现实；实情（指一件事里人人都等却无人记下的那样东西）
H. n. 现实（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人记下的那样东西）

items.q: faced a fact that no clerk in the office would have written

answers.why: face a fact 意为“面对一个事实”，1963 年父亲面对了一个办公室里没有一位办事员肯记下的事实。
fact 意为“事实”，指那一条真相本身而不是说法，它经过了七个冬天而在簿子上没有记号。
fact 意为“事实”，指办公室里每一条旁边的那一条，每一条旁边都有同一行短短的字。
fact 意为“事实”，指留给报告的那一条，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
fact 意为“现实、实情”，指一件事里人人都等却无人记下的那样东西，叔叔说这个现实就是那件事的全部。
fact 意为“现实”，指人人都等却无人记下的那样东西而不是那一条事实，是事情里人人都等、却无人记下的东西。
fact 意为“事实”，指卷宗上写到、被记下的那一条，到 1970 年这一条成了卷宗里的一行。
fact 意为“事实”，父亲一月写道，整件事的事实之事是一间办公室和七个冬天的记下。
fact 意为“事实”，我记得的是卷宗上记下的那一条，1973 年结束了，至今仍被说成办公室里最安静的一条。
fact 为抽象总称，母亲 1975 年说，一条事实是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的东西。
